continuity_state: The Hearth expansion rejected a single Human, Canine or Command profile. The members built four negotiated entrances and accepted a 9% redundancy cost. Human food poisoned Borscht; canine stabilization cost 4 Supply while a prohibited medical Cache revived Vale for 1 Supply and rewarded Favor, exposing unequal System valuation. The settlement adopted species-specific food and medicine rules, forfeiting the unified efficiency bonus. Borscht is recovering, Vale survived, Nika's anger is easing through observed choices rather than restored Bond, and Rook has returned with six warehouse dogs and a tribute ring.
